name: London-Session Momentum Carry
hypothesis: FX/metals that trend >=0.5 daily ATR through the London morning and sit in the outer quarter of the session range at 13:00 London extend into the 16:00 London fix.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; fixed 0.30 daily-ATR stop; 2.2R objective; one decision per instrument per day; flat by 16:30 London.
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
